environment.build: production-mode Electron, local working-tree renderer including preview exit changes
environment.project: Editable offline copy of 海外 O 端 4.0.1

method: Invoked Studio commands in a real Electron StudioWindow with all 17 artboards mounted. Four samples per action, alternating direction or value. Project reads use a local fixture and no project writes reach a server.

Normal idle samples are 550ms with the published AppShell clock. For the controlled run and DOM comparison only, delayed that clock beyond the experiment. The first controlled idle window includes three startup commits on one board.

Observation window in controlled samples extends through the second requestAnimationFrame callback plus 450ms. twoRafMs includes command execution and scheduling, and is not a compositor or physical-input latency.
interactiveGuard is a private diagnostic branch that bypasses the variant sync transaction only for components with no linked variant state. Product code was not changed by this audit.
DOM comparison is a separate run. Compared ordered .__wab_placeholder markers (val key, parent val key and text), and IDs/text of style[id^=plasmic-] in every artboard. This does not compare pixels.

fields.visits: sum of cache instance counts at start of those scans
fields.nodes: renderTplNode cache-miss callbacks per artboard, including repeat executions
fields.commits: React onCommitFiberRoot calls whose root container belongs to the artboard document
fields.calls: counts by nested Studio method call path
fields.scanMs: cumulative time in per-board policy preparation
